paper_metadata.title: Mild head injury—a close relationship between motor function at 1 week post-injury and overall recovery at 3 and 6 months

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study provides a detailed description of the recruitment source, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and baseline characteristics. While it is a relatively small sample (n=37), the recruitment from a principal regional hospital and the clear 'zero-time' description limit selection bias.
